entries.description: Instruction, RGB and robot-state conditioned joint-action inference with causal per-environment visual history.

capability_limits.statement: History starts at the first observation and grows during execution; observations before the episode remain unavailable.

observation_cues: Builds causal visual history during execution, starting with the first observation; prior frames need not exist when the skill is selected.
History provides earlier visual context when the current view loses object identity, relative order or progress through occlusion or containment.

Repeated transfers, handovers or a long instruction alone do not establish missing visual information. If the relevant objects and progress remain observable in current RGB and robot state, temporal context is not required by that observation.
